scientific_integrity: Proof given for all parameter values. Exact finite checks corroborate but do not replace the proof. Priority searches and inspected full articles are not exhaustive; no independent audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one empty vertex, two agent colors, type-homogeneous payoff functions, complete bipartite graph, and strict improving jumps. General payoff functions need not be single-peaked or continuous. Claim is not about multiple vacancies or arbitrary graphs.
title: An exact path potential and equilibrium census for one-vacancy jump dynamics on bicliques
